title: VIXEN codegen configure misses assigned .claude worktree pairing
body: The VIXEN codegen configure auto-derives the Undertow sibling using .claude-worktrees, but this lane uses undertow/.claude/worktrees/d7mrefresh, so it selected /home/liory/projects/undertow and required manual UNDERTOW_ROOT plus VIXEN_KERNEL_PROVIDER_ROOT/VIXEN_KERNEL_PROVIDER_REVISION overrides to regenerate against the row. Suggested consolidation: make the provider pairing resolver understand both worktree layouts and derive the exact paired kernel/Undertow inputs from the landing row.
